title: Anyone else have things in their mall world that is stranger than the constant dirty bathrooms?
content: In my mall world there is a road along the outskirts of the forest thats made of blue shards of broken glass. Everyone calls it broken glass road 🤣🤣 they walk along it frequently without injury.. im also weirdly always looking for my shoes because I have lost them or Im walking around with one shoe on because I just don't seem to care. The amount of dreams I had about missing shoes is unreal almost every time I go to mall world I have no shoes and i go looking for them lol.. thankfully I have never walked along the broken glass road without my shoes. 🤣🤣
